`carto_core::indexer::build_and_persist` (crates/carto-core/src/indexer.rs:36) calls directly:

1. **`pathguard::PathGuard::new(repo_root, out_root, allow_writes_in_repo)`** — constructs the write-confinement guard (INV-3/INV-4) before anything else runs.
2. **`walk::walk(repo_root, respect_gitignore)`** — filesystem walk producing `File`/`Module` nodes (`walked.nodes`), an ignore-rule digest, and per-file SHA-256s.
3. **`lang::extract_and_resolve(repo_root, &walked.nodes)`** — the two-phase per-language extract + whole-repo resolve, returning `resolved.nodes`/`resolved.edges` (Symbol nodes, contains/imports/calls edges).
4. **`graph::Graph::new()` / `Graph::insert_node` / `Graph::insert_edge`** — assembles the in-memory graph from walked nodes + resolved nodes/edges.
5. **`gitinfo::head_sha(repo_root)`** — best-effort current commit SHA for the manifest.
6. **`graph::PersistMeta`** — struct built from the commit SHA, ignore-rule digest, and file SHA-256 map.
7. **`graph::persist(g, meta, &guard)`** — the single write choke-point (sort → redact → validate → size caps → atomic write through `PathGuard`), returning the `manifest` used to fill in `IndexReport`.

It then wraps the results into an `IndexReport` (its own return type) — no other module calls beyond `error::Result` (for its signature) and the `crate::{gitinfo, graph, lang, pathguard, walk}` modules listed above.
